name: context-mode
description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
one_liner: A plug-in for AI coding assistants that stops them from 'forgetting' what they were doing mid-project by cutting the clutter and remembering key details between sessions.
buyer: An engineering manager whose team's AI coding sessions keep losing context and re-explaining themselves on long projects, wasting time and increasing API costs.
business_use_cases: A dev team installs it so their AI agent stops losing track of in-progress tasks and files after long working sessions, cutting rework.
A consultancy that bills AI-assisted development time reduces wasted API spend by cutting redundant context re-sends across a project.
N/A as a third case — this is purely an internal developer-productivity tool, not something with a customer-facing use.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted/managed version with team-wide shared memory and admin dashboards for engineering orgs, on top of the free open-source core.

steal_this: Not much new to build — it's a dev-tool utility already solving its own niche well; the fastest move is installing it into your own AI coding workflow.
